lint.message: The Right Arm launches from a dead start on the first frames of the clip: no pull-back, no hip load, no dip in the 0.6 s before it. Real punches don't pull the hand back; they load the hips (pelvis turn peaks ~50 ms before the hand, shoulders ~35 ms before). Slashes raise first for 0.7-1.4 s. Game telegraphs: player light attacks 0.07-0.1 s, heavies 0.17-0.2 s, NPC attacks the player must read >= 0.34 s (Dark Souls 3).
Keys are evenly spaced (every 0.03 s). Action has rhythm: a quick strike between slower anticipation and recovery, holds of different lengths. Re-time the keys so the beats differ.
